name: What should I consider when choosing an adjustable showerhead?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing an adjustable showerhead?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an adjustable showerhead, consider your desired spray patterns (e.g., massage, rain, mist), water pressure compatibility, and whether you prefer a fixed or handheld option. Look at the material and finish to ensure it complements your bathroom decor. Water efficiency (GPM rating) is also an important factor for reducing water consumption. Check for ease of adjustment mechanisms and durability. Reading reviews can help identify reliable models.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider spray patterns, water pressure, fixed vs. handheld, material, finish, water efficiency, and ease of adjustment.
